name: 02_search_and_portion
prompt: High fidelity premium Android FitnessApp UI mockup board, TWO large readable phone screens side by side, flat UI no device shells, Spanish. Continuous open charcoal #121416 backgrounds, champagne #D8C3A5, ivory #F4F0EA secondary #BCB7AE. SAME SMOKED LIQUID GLASS as selected fitness navigation: subtle translucent charcoal inputs and action pills with warm upper-rim reflections. NO enclosing giant cards, NO glossy borders around all sections, NO neon. Sections directly on background separated by typography and space. Only interactive controls have smoky glass. Cohesive accessible 48dp controls, generous but useful spacing, native Compose typography. Small board caption 'PROPUESTA · DATOS DE EJEMPLO'. All numbers are fictional UI examples, not nutrition guidance. No competitor logos, no fake verified badges. Nested Nutrition flow, back arrow instead of global bottom navigation. LEFT screen 'Añadir alimento', breadcrumb 'Hoy · Comida'. Large smoky glass search input 'Buscar alimento o marca', barcode icon button. Segmented pills 'Recientes', 'Favoritos', 'Mis alimentos'. A clearly labelled button 'Buscar en línea' separate from local search, source caption 'Resultados de ejemplo'. Five compact rows with simple small realistic food thumbnails, food names and preparation state: 'Avena en copos', 'Arroz blanco · cocido', 'Arroz blanco · crudo', 'Yogur natural', 'Pechuga de pollo · cocinada'. Each row shows base 'por 100 g' and source 'Etiqueta manual' or 'Open Food Facts' without verified claim. Bottom quiet '+ Crear alimento' and 'Registro rápido'. RIGHT screen 'Avena en copos', star favorite, small optional bowl thumbnail, source 'Etiqueta introducida · Ejemplo'. Tabs/controls 'Cantidad' and 'Información'. Bold quantity glass input '45' adjacent unit selector 'g', selectable unit chips 'g', 'Ración de 30 g'. Clearly labelled 'Para tu cantidad' then '171 kcal', macros '5,9 g proteínas', '27,9 g carbohidratos', '3,2 g grasas'. Below expandable 'Valores por 100 g' showing '380 kcal'. Meal picker 'Comida', date/time 'Hoy · 14:00'. Persistent champagne 'Añadir al diario'. Make source and weight basis unambiguous; do not pretend photograph determines nutrition. No photo AI scan option.
